snippet.title: Enginefall - Gameplay Trailer | Galaxies Autumn 2025 Showcase
snippet.description:
In Enginefall, the Earth lies in ruins, and humanity’s last refuge is a colossal, ever-moving train. As a “tailie” in servitude, you must rise through the train’s classes, from the undercarriage to the engine, to lead a revolution.

Craft, fight, and scheme your way through a player-driven Railworld. Control your own train, build a home that can survive life on the rails, and raid rival trains for resources.

With high-stakes PvP, survival crafting, and cross-train community building, every choice can sway your fellow survivors into becoming your allies or enemies.

Will you serve the train, or will you seize it with force?
